summary.text: Christopher Schmidt is an independent write-in candidate on the general-election ballot for NY-21 who completed Ballotpedia's 2026 Candidate Connection survey, describing an independent, locally focused campaign.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia lists a Christopher Schmidt as a Libertarian candidate for NY-21 in 2018 who withdrew, and he declared as a write-in candidate for the November 3, 2026 general election. His Ballotpedia page contains no further biographical information.
